Exactly one next step: site-factory reconciles the existing complicated.work owner-gap item and records verified ownership status; do not create, duplicate, requeue, deploy, or change launch state.

Recommendation: preserve complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com as parked and private. Existing owner-gap and readiness work may continue only as bounded repository evidence; no launch, DNS, credentials, analytics, monetization, or deployment changes are authorized.
